commitments.detail: Mina is the primary recipient of Grandpa's telescope per his signed note naming her specifically.
Telescope will be housed in Mina's locked ground-floor closet for security.
Observing sessions are limited to Saturday evenings 8pm-10pm with courtyard access through August 31, 2027.
Before first use, check and adjust mirror collimation, use a red-light flashlight for adjustment and observing, and always place the Dobsonian on a stable solid surface — never on a folding table.
Other relatives may coordinate with Mina to join observing sessions within the available Saturday window, subject to Mina's discretion.
